title: Familiar Vibes and Busy World Map?
content: I had a lot of familiar vibes when listening to a few people on Mall World, like I may have dreamed about some locations, both listed and not (to the extent I know of Mall World). However, it sparked a memory of a book I used to read as a child. If anyone is familiar with Richard Scarry's Busy World and other children's books, the map is very close to what I remember from when I was a child. I, however, do not have the book to check at the moment, but I will add a few images of what I can find. Apparently, there is also a TV show or paid programming on it? [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p\_vzAaUhkOA](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p_vzAaUhkOA) https://preview.redd.it/a73bbc0z5o0g1.jpg?width=665&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=91059f3602452e707c94fc4452bd0b022d88166f https://preview.redd.it/quq5dds06o0g1.jpg?width=2429&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=b80962ccc95c444774110780b6e21434e80bc3f9 [https:\/\/x.com\/DrMMercier\/status\/926437813951836160](https://preview.redd.it/6coujqzm6o0g1.jpg?width=680&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=783c4d3d986142c5266c99ae75388ae1138fbbec) https://preview.redd.it/5obi05rs6o0g1.jpg?width=201&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=4d6f95957c1f1ba873c35841b2174aeb14c25d96 I will talk about dreams another day. I just wanted to put this out there, and see if anyone got similar vibes from the maps. Note: I do feel like this may have been, at the least, an early Mall World map. It, just like us, could have changed with time?
